name: Khan Hratha
summary: Umarak wants a Maraudine Key Fragment from Khan Hratha as leverage for a negotiation. You are asked to challenge Hratha at the highest peak in the Valley of Spears.

sections.title: Umarak’s Concern
sections.body: War grips Desolace, yet the Maraudine centaur remain unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. Umarak fears that the other clans’ inaction may leave them bolder and stir more unrest. He wants the fragment Khan Hratha carries as a bargaining piece, and asks you to bring it back.

faq.q: Who is asking for the Maraudine Key Fragment?
faq.answer: Umarak wants Khan Hratha’s Maraudine Key Fragment as a negotiation tactic.
The Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears, in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Umarak want the fragment?
faq.answer: Umarak wants the Maraudine Key Fragment as leverage for a negotiation.
Umarak fears the Maraudine may grow callous and stir further unrest if the other clans keep ignoring their presence.
Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment.

faq.q: What does Umarak ask you to bring back?
faq.answer: Umarak asks you to bring him the Maraudine Key Fragment.
